A.2.title: AI policy
A.2.objective: The organization shall establish an AI policy.

controls.A.2.2: The organization shall establish an AI policy.
controls.A.2.3: The AI policy shall be aligned with other relevant organizational policies.
controls.A.2.4: The AI policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals and when significant changes occur.

A.3.title: Roles and responsibilities for AI
A.3.objective: Roles and responsibilities for AI shall be defined and assigned.

controls.A.3.2: Roles and responsibilities for AI shall be defined and assigned.
controls.A.3.3: AI issues shall be reported, escalated, and addressed.
controls.A.3.4: Responsibilities toward affected interested parties shall be defined.

A.4.title: Resources
A.4.objective: Appropriate resources for AI systems shall be determined and provided.

controls.A.4.2: Appropriate resources for AI systems shall be determined and provided.
controls.A.4.3: Competence required for AI-related roles shall be established and maintained.
controls.A.4.4: Personnel shall be aware of AI policy, risks, and responsibilities.

A.5.title: AI system impact assessment
A.5.objective: Impact assessments shall be performed for AI systems.

controls.A.5.2: Impact assessments shall be performed for AI systems.
controls.A.5.3: Impact assessments shall be performed at appropriate times across the AI lifecycle.
controls.A.5.4: Impact assessment results shall be reviewed and updated when needed.
controls.A.5.5: Records of impact assessments shall be retained.

A.6.title: AI system design and development
A.6.objective: AI systems shall be designed and developed according to defined requirements.

controls.A.6.2: AI systems shall be designed and developed according to defined requirements.
controls.A.6.3: AI systems shall be verified and validated before use.
controls.A.6.4: Deployment of AI systems shall be controlled.
controls.A.6.5: AI systems shall be operated and monitored.
controls.A.6.6: AI systems shall be maintained over their lifecycle.

A.7.title: Data acquisition
A.7.objective: Data used for AI systems shall be acquired appropriately.

controls.A.7.2: Data used for AI systems shall be acquired appropriately.
controls.A.7.3: Data quality requirements shall be defined and checked.
controls.A.7.4: Data preparation activities shall be controlled.
controls.A.7.5: Data provenance shall be tracked and maintained.
controls.A.7.6: Data selection criteria shall be defined and applied.
controls.A.7.7: Data shall be handled securely and appropriately.

A.8.title: Information to interested parties
A.8.objective: Relevant information about AI systems shall be provided to interested parties.

controls.A.8.2: Relevant information about AI systems shall be provided to interested parties.
controls.A.8.3: Information provided shall support transparency of AI system behavior.
controls.A.8.4: Appropriate explainability information shall be made available.
controls.A.8.5: Users shall receive guidance for the intended use of AI systems.

A.9.title: Responsible use
A.9.objective: AI systems shall be used responsibly.

controls.A.9.2: AI systems shall be used responsibly.
controls.A.9.3: Human oversight shall be defined and implemented.
controls.A.9.4: Use of AI systems shall be monitored for unintended behavior.
controls.A.9.5: Inputs and outputs of AI systems shall be monitored as needed.

A.10.title: Supplier requirements
A.10.objective: Requirements for suppliers and external providers shall be defined.

controls.A.10.2: Requirements for suppliers and external providers shall be defined.
controls.A.10.3: Requirements from customers and users shall be identified and addressed.
controls.A.10.4: Third-party relationships shall be monitored and reviewed.
controls.A.10.5: Appropriate contractual controls shall be established.
